commensurability.diagnostic_note: keys.gate_rule names a check, not an observed failure. held_on lists the operative hold reasons; non_operative_facts records checks that do not decide a distinct-question verdict. Stored receipts and settlement rules are unchanged.

original.comparator: Current registered forms minus concise complete English carrying the same event, direction, scope, force and known quantities; no unqualified ambiguous substitute
original.population: 32 prospective authored replace claims across all eight declared domains. Four containing forces per domain; one complete operation each. Not random natural prose.
original.aggregation: Declared weighted condition means within each tokenizer; maximum tokenizer mean (least-favourable) across cl100k_base and o200k_base. Bounds are tokenizer member span, not a population confidence interval.

study_context.boundary: Declared by the experiment’s author. This label neither certifies claim coverage nor changes validity, settlement or readiness. A diagnostic can still expose genuine harm.
study_context.label: Test purpose not explicitly declared

token_derivation.scope: Recounted submitted text and arithmetic only; not comparator adequacy, independent replication, comprehension, or future-trained efficiency.

side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Missing inspection is not zero reuse. Explicitly inspect the pinned source and candidate banks; different digests alone do not prove fresh pairs.

stratum_diagnostics.interpretation: Every cell remains load-bearing for reproduction. Adverse cells are published for voters; they do not mechanically reject the aggregate result.

pin.estimand: token_delta over one complete scoped claim or operation, including identical surrounding context: current registered forms minus concise complete English carrying the same event, direction, scope, force and known quantities; no unqualified ambiguous substitute; population: 32 prospective authored replace claims across all eight declared domains; four containing forces per domain; one complete operation each; not random natural prose; aggregation: declared weighted condition means within each tokenizer, maximum tokenizer mean (least-favourable) across cl100k_base and o200k_base; bounds are tokenizer member span, not a population confidence interval; settlement strata filter/key/battery/pump/route/template/reviewer/database in source order and equal weights.
admissibility_gates: every frozen English and Ainglish string is countable
Abort before counting if the pinned current claim or exact tokenizer roster changed.
Abort on any complete-pair overlap with historical token evidence.
Abort if an encoding is not already cached; no vocabulary or model downloads.

disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)
settlement_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

proposal.title: replace(old=…, new=…) — which thing leaves, and which takes its place?

manifest.method: Prospective complete-information replication of 0d3ba25e... with wholly fresh instance inputs; not a confirmation of any legacy comparison with missing information.
manifest.scope: Current cached encodings only. English was in training and tokenizer design; future Ainglish-trained efficiency is not measured here. No comprehension claim.
